title: Yellow Yonder Norwegian Fish Gratin
description: A sour and aerated Norwegian fish dish featuring full fat sour cream and beurre-monte. Perfect for an adventurous dinner.
instructions: Season the cod fish fillets with salt, black pepper, and chopped fresh dill.
In a separate bowl, mix together the full fat sour cream, beurre-monte, lemon juice, and chopped fresh chives.
Grease a baking dish with olive oil and place the cod fish fillets in it.
Pour the sour cream mixture over the cod fish fillets.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
While the gratin is baking, heat the vegan butter substitute in a small saucepan over low heat.
After 12 minutes, remove the gratin from the oven and brush the top with the melted vegan butter substitute.
Return the gratin to the oven and bake for an additional 4-6 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
